data.name: Chery
data.gender_notes: Chery is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'ceorl' meaning 'man' or 'person' and 'gyrene' meaning 'dear' or 'precious'. The name Chery signifies a cherished or beloved man or person. The name Chery carries the meaning “Cherished” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chery usually hope their child will grow to embody cherished and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the love and care of God for His children.
data.etymology: Chery belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cherished.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chery total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chery, while not a commonly used name today, can be traced back to Old English origins. It was once a popular name for both men and women during the Middle Ages, signifying a cherished or valued person. In a time where names held significant importance in expressing one's heritage and identity, Chery would have been a reminder of the worth and value of each individual in society.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Chery can be seen as a reminder of the inherent worth and value that each person holds in the eyes of God. As the Bible states in Psalms 139:14-15, "I will praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Wonderful are your works; my soul knows it very well. My frame was not hidden from you, when I was being made in secret, intricately woven in the lowest parts of the earth." In this light, Chery can serve as a reminder of the divine worth and preciousness each person carries within them, as they continue to grow and flourish in their faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cherub, a symbol of divine protection and God's presence, inspires the name Chery. It echoes the joy and innocence of a cherished child, reminding us of God's love and care.
